mainEntity.name: What is shop-floor weld data capture software?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is the app welders use to record work as it happens — which joint, which parameters, by whom, and when — so every weld is traceable back to the person and procedure behind it. Elenchon runs that capture on-premise, keeping the record on hardware you own.

mainEntity.name: How fast is data entry on the floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The mobile-first interface is built to get an operator to the right project step and inputting data in ten seconds or less, using touch-and-PIN sign-in so entries are attributed without slowing anyone down.

mainEntity.name: Can it capture work when there is no Wi-Fi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Offline work capture holds entries in a durable on-device queue and syncs them automatically, in order, when the connection returns — so nothing is lost in a dead zone. It is included on the Standard plan; the offline document viewer is available on every plan.

No. You can define custom work types — fit-up, cutting, assembly, or any process — save them as organization-wide templates, and capture any floor activity in the same traceable structure as your welds.

mainEntity.name: Is captured data stored on-premise or in the cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: On-premise. Elenchon is a containerized appliance installed in your facility, so captured work never touches a shared cloud server. Authorised staff and auditors can still connect remotely through Phrakton, a zero-trust, post-quantum-safe overlay.
